passive.name: Signature of the Visionary
passive.resolvedDescription: Hwei primes enemy champions he damages with his abilities for his signature finishing touch. Hitting an enemy with a second damaging spell completes his signature, leaving it beneath them. The signature detonates after a short delay, dealing magic damage to all enemies in range.

Q.name: Subject: Disaster
Q.resolvedDescription: Hwei paints visions of disaster that deal large damage to enemies. Devastating Fire Hwei launches a blazing fast fireball that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 50/80/110/140/170 (+80% AP) plus 3/4/5/6/7% max health magic damage. Severing Bolt Hwei strikes over far distances with a delayed lightning bolt, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 (+30% AP) magic damage. Hitting an Isolated or Immobilized target increases the damage up to {{ tooltip_qwbonusdamage }} magic damage, based on the target's missing health. Molten Fissure Hwei unleashes a path of eruptions, dealing 20/35/50/65/80 (+30% AP) magic damage in an area and leaving behind pools of lava that Slow enemies by {{ spell.hweiqe:slowpercent }}% and deal 20/35/50/65/80 (+24% AP) magic damage per second for {{ spell.hweiqe:duration }} seconds.

W.name: Subject: Serenity
W.resolvedDescription: Hwei paints visions of serenity that provide utility for himself and allied champions. Fleeting Current Hwei launches a current of swift waters in a line that grants allies {{ tooltip_wqmovespeed }} Move Speed. Pool of Reflection Hwei forms a protective pool that grants 100/140/180/220/260 (+60% AP) Shields over time to allied champions inside reduced by {{ spell.hweiww:tooltipallymod*100 }}% for allies. Stirring Lights Hwei creates three swirling lights that empower his next three Abilities or Attacks to deal an additional 20/30/40/50/60 (+15% AP) magic damage and restore 45/50/55/60/65 Mana each.

E.name: Subject: Torment
E.resolvedDescription: Hwei paints visions of torment that control enemies. Grim Visage Hwei launches a terrifying face that causes the first enemy hit to Flee for 1/1.125/1.25/1.375/1.5 second(s) and take 70/110/150/190/230 (+65% AP) magic damage. Gaze of the Abyss Hwei forms an eye that lingers and provides vision locking onto the first enemy champion that enters and launching a homing missile that Roots the first enemy hit for 1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2 seconds dealing 70/110/150/190/230 (+65% AP) magic damage. Crushing Maw Hwei paints a set of jaws at a target location that Drags enemies to the center dealing 70/110/150/190/230 (+65% AP) magic damage and Slowing enemies caught by 40/47.5/55/62.5/70% decaying over 1.25 seconds.

R.name: Spiraling Despair
R.resolvedDescription: Hwei launches a vision of pure despair that sticks to an enemy champion for 3 seconds. The vision expands over time applying a Slow to enemies for 10% stacking every 0.25 seconds, and dealing 10/20/30 (+5% AP) magic damage per second. Upon completion, the vision shatters, dealing 200/325/450 (+80% AP) magic damage.
